fusions.name: Webbed Rockfall
fusions.desc: Drops a cone of silk-bound rubble ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 35% chance to leave [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Anchored Threads
fusions.desc: Hurls a weighted line that deals 5 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Burrowed Lurk
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds, and you move 10% faster while it lasts. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Gravel Weaver
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of earth that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
